title: Josh Brolin sells Georgia estate for $4M after price cuts
summary_full: Josh Brolin sold his Sandy Springs estate for $4 million, after initially listing it at nearly $5 million. The home features seven bedrooms and traditional design elements that appeal to potential buyers in the area. Brolin and his wife originally purchased the property for $3.25 million in 2020 and considered renting it out at first. The sale aligns with their recent move to California following Brolin's film work in Atlanta.
